newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to grow 3 pct comfortably in 1997 - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain to grow 3 pct comfortably in 1997 - Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday that Spain would comfortably manage three percent growth in 1997.
"This year we will have growth at three percent comfortably," Montoro told a seminar in Madrid.
Montoro added that the national statistics institute (INE)'s data released this morning confirmed the recovery of the Spanish economy will continue this year.
Spanish first-quarter gross domestic product rose 2.9 percent year-on-year versus a 2.6 percent rise in the last quarter of 1996. GDP rose 0.9 percent in the first quarter over the previous quarter.
